Verified domain boomsupersonic.com (Boom Supersonic / Boom Technology, Denver/Centennial CO; founded 2014 by Blake Scholl; Y Combinator alum). Building the Overture supersonic airliner, Symphony engine and Superpower gas turbines. Series A $33M (Mar 2017; company said total funding then $41M), Series B $100M (Jan 2019, led by Emerson Collective; included ~$56M new money plus previously announced strategic investments; total then over $141M), and a $300M round closed Dec 2025 led by Darsana Capital at a ~$1.5B post-money valuation (BusinessDen), which Boom's own release also calls its 'Series B'. Boom raised further undisclosed amounts between 2020 and 2024 that are not itemized by primary sources, so amount_raised is left blank (sourced rounds alone sum to $441M+ including pre-2017 seed). Airline pre-orders/deposits and turbine orders (Crusoe $1.25B backlog) are not equity. Strategic investment by Japan Airlines (2017) was part of the pre-Series B total.

ramp.com; HQ New York; corporate cards/spend management. Major rounds: $25M (Feb 2020, Founders Fund), Series B $115M (Apr 2021, D1 & Stripe; $1.6B), Series C $300M (Aug 2021, Founders Fund; $3.9B), Mar 2022 $200M equity (part of $750M incl. $550M debt; $8.1B), Series D $300M (Aug 2023; $5.8B), D-2 $150M (Apr 2024; $7.65B), Series E $200M (Jun 2025; $16B), E-2 $500M (Jul 2025, ICONIQ; $22.5B), $300M (Nov 2025, Lightspeed; $32B), $750M (Jun 2026, ICONIQ/GIC/OTPP; $44B). Ramp said total equity was $2.3B as of Nov 2025 and 'more than $3B' after June 2026; amount_raised = $2.3B + $750M. A late-2020 ~$30M Series A3 (D1/Coatue) is not itemized. Bloomberg reported (Oct 2026, unconfirmed by Ramp) a further ~$1.85B round at ~$60B pre-money led by Dragoneer and Thrive; excluded from rounds/total until confirmed.
